gbm_population_evidence.quote: The presence of IDH mutation prior to enrollment

candidate_evidence.quote: Berubicin intravenously infused will be administered at a dose of 7.1 mg/m2 as free base (equivalent to 7.5 mg/m2 Berubicin HCl)

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Plasma samples will be collected from the first approximately 18 patients enrolled, and concentrations of Berubicin and its metabolite, berubicinol, will be measured

role_evidence.quote: The first 18 patients will undergo a pK assessment of Berubicin and it's active metabolite Berubicinol during the dosing days of the first two cycles.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational anthracycline (doxorubicin analogue) intended to cross the blood-brain barrier
arms: pK Assessment of Berubicin and its active metabolite

source_quote.quote: The presence of IDH mutation prior to enrollment
results of routinely used methods for MGMT methylation testing (e.g., methylation-specific polymerase chain reaction \[MSPCR\] or quantitative polymerase chain reaction \[PCR\]) are acceptable.

coder_notes: IDH mutation is an exclusion (i.e. IDH-wildtype required); not candidate-matched. MGMT methylation status must be available but no particular status is required; coded as eligibility only because availability of the result is an entry requirement (a weak case, adjudicator may downgrade to exploratory). PK is plasma-only (tumour_pk_planned = no).
